pulls.title: Rework the lab into a GitHub-driven build facility
pulls.body:
<!-- ccr-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"TheSandemon"} -->
_Requested by **Sand** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01XGMuX9jzMGcRiUeBYEWt9w?thread=cmsg_01XGMuX9jzMGcRiUeBYEWt9wXWUazGGGifh1HdeEevZoZp)_

Before: the profile lab was a cozy room with a sunset window, a reactor and glassware around the six-month contribution chart, all generated by one script.

After: the lab is a build facility with no character in it. A reactor core powers up to five machine bays, one per repo you worked on in the last 14 days, through cables whose energy flow speeds up with activity. A HUD shows activity, system condition and mode, the six-month history monitor stays at the center, and a build log cycles your recent public events. Empty bays sit dark as "BAY OFFLINE". Every animation loops forever.

GitHub events become durable states rather than one-shot moments: activity (sleeping / tinkering / building / overclocked), condition (stable / energized / warning / critical, from workflow status), and mode (research / experimenting / open-source / shipping). Condition sets the palette and hazard stripes; activity sets loop tempo, cable flow and ambient light.

How: `scripts/update_lab.py` is split into `fetch-github-data.py` (writes a trimmed `data/snapshot.json`), `compute-lab-state.py` (writes `data/lab-state.json`) and `generate-lab-svg.py` (writes `assets/lab.svg`), with shared helpers in `lab_common.py`. `update_lab.py` remains as a one-command wrapper and re-exports the old functions, so the existing tests run unchanged; four new tests cover machines, modes, JSON round-trip, every palette/tempo combination and event trimming. `config/lab.json` gains `ignore_repos` and `machine_slots`. The workflow now runs tests, then the three stages, commits `assets/lab.svg` and `data/` only when they change, and also runs on pushes to `main` that touch scripts, config or the workflow.

Note: the committed `assets/lab.svg` is rendered from `tests/fixtures/snapshot.json`, built offline from the previous SVG's contribution line and this repo's own commits, so it shows one active bay. The first workflow run after merge replaces it with live data.

pulls.title: Add harness panels built from real GitHub work
pulls.body:
<!-- ccr-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"TheSandemon"} -->
_Requested by **Sand** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01XGMuX9jzMGcRiUeBYEWt9w?thread=cmsg_01XGMuX9jzMGcRiUeBYEWt9wC7yCKksBRtdzLdk7255hSM)_

Before: the profile showed only the lab SVG, then Featured work.

After: a new "Work traces" section sits under the lab with three looping panels, each filled from real PRs and commits:
- **Agent chat**: the top task (PR title) as the request, plan steps pulled from the PR body's bullets, files touched, and the result (merged / in review / draft).
- **Terminal orchestrator**: a scrolling commit log across repos with per-repo activity meters and a blinking cursor.
- **Plan / build / verify / ship**: a pipeline for a second PR, with the stage matching the PR state glowing (draft lights build, open lights verify, merged lights ship).

Every animation repeats forever: cursors, pulses, moving dashes, scanlines, the scrolling log. There are no one-shot animations.

How: `scripts/update_harness.py` reuses the lab script's JSON and API helpers. It searches public PRs and commits, fetches file lists for the top PRs, and filters and ranks them through `config/profile-visuals.json`. That config holds repo aliases, ignored repos, ignored title patterns, pinned `featured` PRs, custom `summaries`, and the order, labels and visibility of the panels. The script rewrites only the marked block in `README.md`. The workflow (renamed "Update profile visuals") now also runs on pushes that touch config or scripts. It runs the tests, generates both sections, and commits only outputs that changed. The harness step uses the default Actions token, and the search adds `is:public`, so private work never shows up in the panels. The committed SVGs were rendered from a snapshot of this repo's real PRs and commits (`tests/fixtures/harness-snapshot.json`). The first scheduled run replaces them with account-wide data.

Tests: `python -m unittest discover -s tests` (14 passing, 11 new).

pulls.title: Make six-month history the centerpiece of Sandemon's Lab
pulls.body:
## Summary
- Remove the portrait and make the six-month contribution archive the largest element in Sandemon's Lab.
- Backfill every day in the rolling six-month window via GitHub GraphQL and scroll the line continuously; keep the reactor, beakers, window, and status displays animated.
- Fix skyline windows, replace technical status copy with playful lab language, and use LadderStar's published Open Graph preview and current description.
- Default to public contributions; allow a read-only LAB_HISTORY_TOKEN secret if private contribution counts should appear in the public SVG.

## Verification
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- Browser rendered the generated SVG at README width.
- GitHub Actions update workflow succeeded twice on this branch; its own token generated the public six-month SVG.

pulls.title: Build Sandemon's animated pixel lab profile
pulls.body:
## Summary
- Replace the GIF header with a looping, activity-driven pixel lab featuring a scientist based on the green-suit portrait.
- Keep only LadderStar in Featured work, with a linked SVG feature card; remove the requested sections and update the title.
- Add a standard-library generator, config, scheduled/manual GitHub Actions update, and state tests.

## Verification
- `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`
- `python scripts/update_lab.py` against live public GitHub activity
- Parsed both SVGs as XML and inspected browser renders at README width.

commits.message:
Rework the lab into a GitHub-driven build facility (#4)

Splits the lab into fetch, compute-state and generate stages, adds machine bays, durable activity/condition/mode states and a cycling build log. The shared workflow now runs tests, the three lab stages and the harness panels, then commits only changed outputs.

Add harness panels built from real GitHub work (#3)

Adds three looping SVG panels (agent chat, terminal orchestrator, plan/build/verify/ship) under the lab, filled from public PRs and commits and curated through config/profile-visuals.json.

Make six-month history the centerpiece of Sandemon's Lab (#2)

* Redesign lab around six-month history monitor

* Update lab status

* Allow opt-in private history counts
